main.description: A page of the site, made of blocks (docs/v4/themes.md). The key is the page's address: 'home' for /, 'about' for /about/. A draft of a page is a record under '<key>~draft' (e.g. 'home~draft'), which the site shows only at the page's address with ?preview=draft; anything that lists pages leaves out keys with a '~'. The site's code defines each kind of block; a record only picks them, orders them and sets their options.

title.description: The page's title, in the browser tab and in search results, and its heading unless that's hidden.

description.description: What search results and link previews say about the page.

card.description: The page's share card, drawn by the admin app when the page is published. Without one, the home page uses the site's card.

width.description: How wide the page is: narrow for reading (the default), wide for grids.

hideHeading.description: Leave out the page's heading, e.g. when a block has its own.

blocks.description: The page's blocks, in reading order.

block.description: One block on the page, and where it sits. Blocks flow into rows: a full one alone, two halves or three thirds side by side. On a phone every block is full width, in the same order.

width.description: How much of a row the block takes: full (the default), half or third.

block.description: The block. A kind of block this site doesn't know is left out of the page, and the admin app keeps it as it is.

profile.description: Jeff's avatar, a greeting as the page's main heading, a tagline, and his status, which keeps itself current.

tagline.description: The line under the heading, in the accent colour.

text.description: Markdown: paragraphs, headings, lists, links, bold and italics. Raw HTML shows as text.

links.description: A list of links: in a line after its label (e.g. 'Elsewhere:'), or as buttons.

label.description: What the list is, e.g. 'Elsewhere': shown before the links, or read out by screen readers for buttons.

href.description: A path on skiddle.id (/rss.xml), a place on the page (#work), or a full URL: https://… or mailto:….

me.description: One of Jeff's own profiles (rel="me"), so the profile can check it links back here.

primary.description: As a button, stands out in the accent colour.

now.description: What Jeff is doing now: the Now page's list (id.skiddle.now), with when it was updated.

thisWeek.description: This week on the timeline: its events, and a count of its posts, status changes and notes. Left out when the week is empty.

projects.description: Picked projects (id.skiddle.project), as cards, in order.
The id.skiddle.project records to show, in order.

recentPosts.description: The newest posts, under the series' cards. A series shows only its newest part, since its card covers the rest.

limit.description: How many posts: 4 if left out.

hideSeries.description: Leave out the series' cards, and list every part of a series as a post.

testimonials.description: The first five testimonials of the Services page (id.skiddle.services), one at a time, sliding.

callToAction.description: A box with a heading, a line and buttons, e.g. asking people to work with Jeff.

links.description: The buttons; one marked primary stands out.

facts.description: Jeff's avatar beside facts about him, a label and a value each, as neofetch prints them, with buttons to pick the site's accent colour. Its heading, if it has one, is the page's main heading, above the card.

heading.description: The page's main heading, above the card, e.g. 'About me'. Left out, the card has none.

section.description: A section of text, under its own heading when it has a title.

title.description: The section's heading. Without one, the text follows the block before it.

anchor.description: The heading's id, so a link can point at it (#outside): lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Made from the title when it's left out.

text.description: Markdown: paragraphs, headings, lists, links, bold and italics. Raw HTML shows as text.

principles.description: How Jeff works: numbered cards, two to a row.

soFar.description: Jeff's life so far: a line for each year, oldest first, ending with what he's doing now.

current.description: The last line: what Jeff is doing now.

href.description: Where to read more: a path on skiddle.id (/posts/…) or a full https:// URL.

link.description: The link's text: 'read the post' if it's left out.

contact.description: Ways to reach Jeff: a heading, a line, and buttons with icons for email, Bluesky and GitHub. The one marked primary stands out.

nowFull.description: What Jeff is doing now, in full: a heading, the page's main heading, and a lead, when it was last updated, the intro and the whole list (id.skiddle.now).

heading.description: The page's main heading. The page hides its own.

text.description: The line under the heading, in Markdown: links, bold and italics.
